# Bulk Email Verifier & MX/SMTP Deliverability Checker (`bulk-email-verifier-mx-smtp-mcp-api`)

> Verify thousands of B2B email addresses with direct DNS MX lookups, SMTP handshake simulation, and disposable domain detection. $0 proxy fees and <50ms checks.

## Endpoints & Connections
- Apify Store URL: https://apify.com/deepaksheoran172/bulk-email-verifier-mx-smtp
- Remote MCP (Streamable HTTP): `https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=deepaksheoran172/bulk-email-verifier-mx-smtp`
- Stdio MCP: `npx -y @apify/actors-mcp-server --actors deepaksheoran172/bulk-email-verifier-mx-smtp`
- Standby HTTP API: `https://deepaksheoran172--bulk-email-verifier-mx-smtp.apify.actor`
- Full 63-Actor Catalog: https://deepakshe.github.io/b2b-mcp-apify-scrapers-hub/llms.txt
